# FinCalcHub Marketing

An ultra-responsive suite of client-side digital marketing, crypto, and financial calculators processing calculations natively inside user web browsers.

## Core Pages

- [Calculators Hub](https://fincalchub.xyz): Main execution dashboard featuring live CoinGecko API crypto conversions, amortized loan estimators, and digital marketing CPM/ROI metric funnels.
- [FAQ](https://fincalchub.xyzfaq): Public resource index covering programmatic formulas, live data pipelines, and customer support routing channels.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fincalchub.xyzprivacy): AdSense regulatory declaration detailing local data non-retention policies and cookie safety protocols.
- [Terms of Service](https://fincalchub.xyzterms): Platform usage rules, client-side browser execution parameters, and financial liability waiver framework.

## Technical Specifications

- **Front-End Architecture:** Built completely with lightweight HTML5 and Tailwind CSS for mobile-optimized rendering speeds.
- **Data Retention Framework:** Zero server-side tracking logs. All financial calculation states use ephemeral client-side JavaScript memory models.
- **External Integration Feeds:** Real-time digital asset exchange calculations pull directly from CoinGecko's REST API simple price endpoints.
